plan.title: Winning and Losing Vendor Award Visibility

Switch to Vendor B's supplier-portal session.
Open the awarded event in Vendor B's portal and remain on its overview.
Verify Vendor B sees the awarded status.
Verify the vendor portal shows the event quantity in the awarded context.
Verify the awarded vendor's displayed amount matches the event's bid total held by the API.
